description: This file contains unit tests for Orleans' JSON serialization support using System.Text.Json. It includes tests for deep copying, round-trip serialization, polymorphic handling of JsonNode types, and serialization of JsonDocument and JsonElement types, specifically within the Orleans serialization framework.

classes.name: JsonCodecTests
classes.description: Unit tests for Orleans' JSON serialization, including deep copy, round-trip serialization, and polymorphic handling of JsonNode types.

classes.name: JsonCodecCopierTests
classes.description: Unit tests for deep copying Orleans' JSON types, including JsonNode subtypes and JsonDocument/JsonElement.

methods.name: JsonSerializerDeepCopy
methods.description: Tests that custom types can be deep copied through the JSON codec, verifying Orleans' deep copy functionality.

methods.name: JsonSerializerRoundTrip
methods.description: Verifies round-trip serialization and deserialization of MyJsonClass objects through Orleans' codec and serializer systems.

methods.name: CanSerializeJsonValue_AsJsonNode
methods.description: Tests that JsonValue can be serialized when stored as JsonNode, both untyped and typed.

methods.name: CanSerializeAllJsonNodeTypes
methods.description: Tests serialization of all JsonNode subtypes (JsonValue, JsonObject, JsonArray) and complex nested structures.

methods.name: CanSerializeJsonDocumentAndElement
methods.description: Tests serialization of JsonDocument and JsonElement types within Orleans' serialization system.

methods.name: CanCopyNativeJsonTypes
methods.description: Tests deep copying of JsonValue, JsonArray, and JsonObject types.

methods.name: CanCopyJsonDocumentAndElement
methods.description: Tests deep copying of JsonDocument and JsonElement, ensuring copies are independent.
